credits.title: Ghost Soldiers
credits.overview: Amidst a hail of bullets and the flames of war, the Thai soldiers with hearts of steel from the Black Panthers Division must awaken their primal instincts, unite their strength to fight tooth and nail on a foreign battlefield, to protect their comrades and return home with honor and dignity.

credits.title: Someone Special
credits.overview: A man and a woman, living just a floor apart, are battling personal traumas. They are brought together by a twist of fate, kindling an unexpected relationship.

credits.title: Halabala
credits.overview: Inspector Dan leads the team of infirm police officers to hunt down the brutal escaped prisoner in the Halabala forest down south, only to discover that the dark secret inside the forest is turning against them.

credits.title: 4 Kings II
credits.overview: After a drug dealer schemes against them in secret, two student gangs ignite a bitter feud that triggers a chain of violent consequences.

credits.title: 4 Kings
credits.overview: Inspired by the real story of the conflict between the student from four different technician colleges in the 90s, where violence can be used to build friendships and enemies at the same time.

credits.title: Come Here
credits.overview: Four young travelers embark on a trip to Kanchanaburi to see the museum, but pass the time in other ways when they find out it's closed for refurbishment.

credits.title: App War
credits.overview: Two like-minded app entrepreneurs discover that the apps they're developing are similar, and the pair fight tooth and nail to come out on top. Meanwhile, sparks begin to fly between the two rivals.

credits.title: My Marathon
credits.overview: A marathon has 8 stages before the finish line. So does life.

credits.title: Die Tomorrow
credits.overview: Die Tomorrow entails six short segments about the impermanence of life, all inspired by deaths reported in Thai daily newspapers.
